FAQsWhat are the benefits of the Citi® Diamond Preferred® Credit Card?The Citi® Diamond Preferred® Credit Card comes with all the benefits of a Citi credit card, including a payment due date of your choice, 24/7 customer service and $0 liability for unauthorized charges.What credit score do I need to qualify for a Citi® Diamond Preferred® Credit Card?Approval for the Citi® Diamond Preferred® Credit Card depends on several factors, not just credit score. However, it's generally recommended to have a credit score in the good to the excellent range to apply for the Citi® Diamond Preferred® Credit Card.Does Citi® Diamond Preferred® Credit Card have an annual fee?There is no annual fee1 with the Citi® Diamond Preferred® Credit Card.Does Citi® Diamond Preferred® Credit Card earn rewards?While the Citi® Diamond Preferred® Credit Card does not earn rewards, it does offer benefits such as a low intro balance transfer fee, no annual fee1, Citi® Flex Pay2, access to Merchant Offers, free access to your FICO® Score and $0 liability on unauthorized charges.Does Citi have other credit cards with low intro APR offers for balance transfers?Yes, Citi offers multiple credit cards with low intro APR benefits for balance transfers. You can compare Citi’s balance transfer credit cards and choose the one that best fits your needs.Is there a fee for balance transfers on the Citi® Diamond Preferred® Credit Card?The Citi® Diamond Preferred® Credit Card typically charges a fee for balance transfers. The exact fee, including if the card has an intro balance transfer fee promotion, is disclosed during the application process and in your card agreement.How long does a balance transfer take with the Citi® Diamond Preferred® Credit Card?We will begin processing Balance Transfer requests 14 days after the account is opened. You can modify or cancel your request any time during this 14-day period. After the 14-day period, Balance Transfers can take up to 10 days to process.Can I manage my Citi® Diamond Preferred® Credit Card online or through an app?Yes. Cardmembers can manage their account, track balances, schedule payments and set alerts through citi.com or the Citi Mobile® App.Citi® Diamond Preferred® Credit CardSave big on interest Get our longest-lasting intro rate on balance transfers.
